desc:
👶 GROW UP! 👴
Live a whole life in one game!

Start as a baby in the hospital nursery and grow up stop by stop. Daycare, the school bus, picture day, a field trip, your driving test, graduation, your first job, a vacation, retirement… all the way up to Cloud Nine! ☁️

🎁 A surprise at every stop: collect funny finds from Common to Mythic in your Life Album
📖 Every life ends with its own Life Story, with a title like “The Sneezing Astronaut”
🎡 Spin the Wheel of Next Lives and live it all again
😂 Bonk your friends, scare the whole server, make it rain toys
🚌 Take over as the bus driver, the DMV clerk or the gatekeeper of the clouds
🚗 Ride to school in a limo, take your driving test in a supercar, float up in your own golden balloon

How will YOUR life turn out?
